title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
abstract: A comprehensive, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the Erdős–Szekeres Convex Polygon Theorem (1935). Formalizes orientation determinants, general position, 2D rotation transformations with finite slope avoidance (rotating any finite set to have mutually distinct x-coordinates), x-coordinate sorting, cup-cap sequences with Pascal-type binomial split recurrences, halfspace separation for convex hulls, and rotation invariance of convex polygons. Proves that any finite set of at least choose(2k - 4, k - 2) + 1 points in general position in ℝ² contains the vertices of a strictly convex k-gon, verifying the Happy Ending Theorem under pure general position with no distinct-x-coordinate restriction. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).
